fame.limitation: Rolling-window frozen-pool adaptation; no published dataset/result reproduced.

timerouter.limitation: Port uses a retrained OVA head; the authors' head training code is not released.

onenet.limitation: Two-branch OCP block with frozen experts and delayed feedback; full branch co-adaptation is absent. Online protocol differs from offline routers.

superlinear.limitation: Spectral combination gate over frozen experts; full frequency-expert training is absent.
